title: 第19章 离开剑山秘境第20章 被隔离的空间
content_zh:
“这能力也太逆天了吧！”杨修听到玄水的解释抓住玉佩的手又紧了一些仿佛生怕自己一不小心掉到地上摔碎了。
玄水看到杨修的微动作后脸上浮现了得意的表情轻哼道“本姑娘说你说你没见识你看看没说错吧！”
杨修没有反驳玄水看了看手中的玉佩喃喃道“拥有这种能力的灵器不应该是凡人铸造的吧？”
玄水听到杨修的话生气的开口解释道“喂喂喂！杨修！你到底有没有认真听本小姐说话？我说这是神器！神器！不是灵器！懂不懂？神器凡人肯定是锻造不出的啊！”
杨修尴尬的挠挠头歉意的开口“不好意思啊！太认真听它的能力了没听到你说她是神器！你的话的意思是这个世界上有神对吧！”
“看你一脸不惊讶的样子，你听说过神？”玄水靠近杨修认真看了看他的脸开口问道。
杨修点了点头开口道“不是听说过，是见过！”
玄水听到杨修的话皱眉随后想到了玄武便试探开口“你说的神是小玄武？”
“不！不是，我说的见过的神是一个叫楚浩然的人！”杨修开口解释。
谁知当杨修的话说出时玄水一脸惊讶的看着他随后碎碎念道“不可能啊？你怎么可能见过他！”
杨修挥手从龙血剑召唤而出浮在玄水面前开口道“你看就是我从他那里学来的神品御剑术！”
“你会御剑术？为什么上次和我对战的时候不用？”玄水没有看浮在身前的龙血剑而是一脸生气的对着杨修开口。
“嘿嘿！这不是怕你伤自尊嘛！”杨修笑了笑开口道。
“你！你你！”玄水一甩衣袖转身消失了。
“诶！你别走啊！我还有好多事情没有问清楚呢！你快出来啊！”杨修见玄水消失着急了大声喊道，可是任凭他如何呼唤玄水依旧没有出来。
杨修见玄水好像真的生气了轻声吐槽了一句“明明是外表安全感和稳重拉满的重剑剑灵为啥这么爱生气呢？”
“唰！”玄水没听到杨修吐槽，龙血剑听到了飞过来亲昵的在杨修身边转了两圈像是小狗在讨主人开心一样。
“好好好！知道还是你好！回剑匣休息吧！”杨修伸手摸了摸龙血剑剑柄对着龙血夸赞道，龙血剑很受用听到了杨修的回答便返回了空间剑匣。
杨修将空间剑匣化作的玉佩挂在腰间随后向前看去，才发现自己居然已经登顶了而身后自己印象中的山洞已经不见了取而代之的是山路，而他还差三个台阶就登顶了，但是他还是回头多看了身后的路一眼然后坚定登上最后的三个台阶。
当杨修站在山路最后的终点时，一股震动感从身下传来紧接着一道空间裂隙从杨修身前展开，杨修没有丝毫犹豫的走了进去，待杨修走进去之后出现在杨修眼前的是整个剑山秘境的全貌而他看到自己攀登的山居然从大地里快速拔高最后立于整个剑山秘境之上。

杨修看着巨剑脑海里出现了一句话“它在告别？”，虽然不知道这种情绪哪里来的，但是他的内心告诉他是这样的，最后他眼前一黑仿佛失去了视觉一般，当他眼前再次出现景象的时候，人已经出现在了当时进入剑山秘境时的森林里，而在他身前是他追杀的王虎和林小娜，两人身上已经没有了一丝生机表情全是惊愕，可见两人死前并不开心，杨修摇了摇头转身离去。
当杨修再次回到蛟龙容身之湖后，蛟龙还无力的躺在地上但是它身上的伤口已经消失了，郑元雪在蛟龙身旁烤着火，她始终是个凡人夜晚山上的凉意她肯定是顶不住的。
“你回来的？怎么这么快？看来追击的很顺利啊！”郑元雪见杨修回来一脸欣喜。
“快？我离开了多久？”郑元雪的话让杨修很懵，他前后在剑山秘境待的时间虽然没有十天半个月但是小一周是有的，光是登山所花费的时间就有四天，虽然剑山秘境没有昼夜交替，但是他自己对时间流动的感知告诉他时间是四天没错。
content_en:
"This ability is so incredible!" After hearing Xuan Shui's explanation, Yang Xiu tightened his grip on the jade pendant, as if he was afraid that he would accidentally drop it and break it.
When Xuan Shui saw Yang Xiu's slight movement, a proud expression appeared on his face and he hummed, "I said you said you didn't know anything, please check and see if you are right!"
Yang Xiu did not refute Xuanshui looked at the jade pendant in his hand and murmured, "Spiritual weapons with such abilities shouldn't be forged by mortals, right?"
Xuan Shui heard Yang Xiu's words and explained angrily, "Hey, hey, Yang Xiu! Did you listen to this lady carefully? I said this is a divine weapon! A divine weapon! It's not a spiritual weapon! Do you understand? A mortal cannot forge a divine weapon!"
Yang Xiu scratched his head in embarrassment and said apologetically, "I'm sorry! I listened so carefully to its abilities that I didn't hear you say she was a divine weapon! What you said meant that there are gods in this world, right?"
"Seeing that you don't look surprised, have you ever heard of God?" Xuan Shui approached Yang Xiu and looked at his face seriously and asked.
Yang Xiu nodded and said, "It's not that I've heard of it, it's that I've seen it!"
Xuan Shui frowned when he heard Yang Xiu's words, then thought of Xuanwu and asked tentatively, "The god you are talking about is Xiao Xuanwu?"
"No! No, the god I mentioned was a man named Chu Haoran!" Yang Xiu explained.
Who would have thought that when Yang Xiu said what he said, Xuan Shui looked at him in surprise and muttered, "Impossible? How could you have seen him!"
Yang Xiu waved his hand and summoned the Dragon Blood Sword, floated in front of Xuan Shui and said, "You see, this is the divine sword control technique I learned from him!"
"Do you know how to control a sword? Why didn't you use it when you fought me last time?" Xuan Shui didn't look at the Dragon Blood Sword floating in front of him but spoke to Yang Xiu angrily.
"Hey! I'm not afraid of hurting your self-esteem!" Yang Xiu said with a smile.
"You! You you!" Xuan Shui flicked his sleeves and turned around and disappeared.
"Hey! Don't leave! I still have a lot of things I haven't asked clearly! Come out quickly!" Yang Xiu shouted anxiously when he saw Xuanshui disappearing, but no matter how he called for Xuanshui, he still didn't come out.
Seeing that Xuan Shui seemed really angry, Yang Xiu complained softly, "Why is the heavy sword sword spirit who seems to be safe and stable on the outside so angry?"
"Huh!" Xuan Shui didn't hear Yang Xiu's complaint. Dragon Blood Sword heard it and flew over and circled around Yang Xiu affectionately twice, like a puppy trying to please its owner.
"Okay, okay! It's better for you to know! Go back to the sword box and rest!" Yang Xiu reached out and touched the hilt of the dragon blood sword and praised the dragon blood. The dragon blood sword was very useful. After hearing Yang Xiu's answer, he returned to the space sword box.
Yang Xiu hung the jade pendant transformed from the space sword box on his waist and looked forward, only to realize that he had actually reached the top. The cave behind him had disappeared and was replaced by a mountain road. He was still three steps away from reaching the top, but he still looked back at the road behind him and then climbed the last three steps firmly.
When Yang Xiu stood at the end of the mountain road, a shaking feeling came from under him, and then a space crack opened in front of Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu walked in without any hesitation. After Yang Xiu walked in, what appeared in front of Yang Xiu was the entire Sword Mountain Secret Realm. And he saw that the mountain he climbed quickly rose up from the earth and finally stood on the entire Jian Mountain Secret Realm.
Yang Xiu looked at the giant sword and thought "Is it saying goodbye?". Although he didn't know where this emotion came from, his heart told him that it was like this. In the end, his eyes went dark as if he had lost his vision. When the scene appeared in front of him again , the person had appeared in the forest when he entered the secret realm of Jianshan, and in front of him were Wang Hu and Lin Xiaona, whom he was chasing. There was no trace of life on their bodies, and their expressions were full of shock. It could be seen that the two were not happy before they died. Yang Xiu shook his head and turned to leave.
When Yang Xiu returned to the lake where the dragon lived,The dragon was still lying weakly on the ground, but the wounds on its body had disappeared. Zheng Yuanxue was warming herself on the fire beside the dragon. She was still a mortal and she would definitely not be able to withstand the coolness on the mountain at night.
"You came back? Why so fast? It seems that the pursuit went smoothly!" Zheng Yuanxue looked happy when she saw Yang Xiu coming back.
"Quick? How long have I been gone?" Zheng Yuanxue's words made Yang Xiu very confused. Although the time he spent in the Jianshan Secret Realm was not ten days and a half, it was a week. The time spent climbing alone was four days. Although the Jianshan Secret Realm did not alternate between day and night, his own perception of the flow of time told him that the time was four days.
